bias.label: Leaning down below 3,600; bounce off 3,500 in play

event: Mon 23 Nov 16:45 SAST: US flash PMI. Tue 24 Nov: US consumer confidence (time UNVERIFIED). Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US PCE, GDP, durable goods, jobless claims; 21:00 SAST Beige Book. Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, thin trade. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Early Monday bounce
bullets.text: FXStreet reported gold back above 3,550 in early Asian trade (about 03:09 SAST), on safe-haven buying over AI-stock worries; the exact price is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Brutal last week
bullets.text: Gold closed Friday near 3,538-3,539, down about 9% on the week, after a low near 3,503.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about a 99% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike on 9 December.

bullets.title: Dollar still strong
bullets.text: The dollar is near a 19-month high after a fourth weekly gain, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Analysts lean lower
bullets.text: Kitco's weekly survey has 9 of 15 Wall Street analysts bearish, with 3,430-3,450 named as the next area if 3,500 breaks.

bullets.title: Big data Wednesday
bullets.text: PCE inflation, GDP and durable goods all land Wednesday at 15:30 SAST, before the US holiday thins the market.

bullets.title: Very oversold
bullets.text: After a 9% week, sharp bounces can happen inside the downtrend, so do not chase either side.
